draft.subject: Your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Keiko,

Thanks again for the onboarding call last week. Your notification badge ticket is still open with support, and they'll follow up in that thread.

In the meantime, the usual next step is getting one real project going -- projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through it with you and answer anything else about Wrenfield.

Best,
Chidi
